> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

# Getting Started

> Start testing your M

CP server in minutes

> [!NOTE]
>
> The upcoming SDK 10, CLI 6, and Vitest 0.3 releases require an MCPJam login or `sk_` API k
ey for every eval, including BYOK runs with uploads disabled. These versions must ship after the backend run-start endpoint is dep

loyed. Earlier versions keep their existing behavior.

## 1. Choose how to open Inspector

Every option below opens the MCPJam

Inspector. Pick one based on where your MCP server runs.

> [card] [Web](https://app.mcpjam.com)
>
> No install. HTTPS server

s only. Share servers with your team.

> [card] [Terminal](https://docs.mcpjam.com/installation.md#terminal)
>
> `npx @mcpjam/
inspector@latest`. Requires Node.js. HTTP/S and local STDIO.\n\n> [card] [macOS](https://docs.mcpjam.com/installation.md#desktop-a

pp)
>
> Desktop app (`.dmg`). No Node.js. HTTP/S and local STDIO.

> [card] [Windows](https://docs.mcpjam.com/installation.md#

desktop-app)
>
> Desktop app (`.exe` installer). No Node.js. HTTP/S and local STDIO.

> [card] [Docker](https://docs.mcpjam.co

m/installation.md#docker)
>
> Pull from Docker Hub. HTTP/S, plus STDIO servers that run inside the container.

* **Your server
has a public HTTPS URL**: any option works. The web app needs no install.\n* **Your server runs on `localhost` or over STDIO**: u
se Terminal or the macOS or Windows desktop app. The web app can't reach it.\n* **You want Inspector isolated in a container**: us
e Docker. Reach servers on your machine at `http://host.docker.internal:PORT`, and note that STDIO commands run inside the contain
er, not on your machine.\n\nSee [Installation](https://docs.mcpjam.com/installation.md#which-one-do-i-need) for the full compariso

n.

## 2. Connect a server

On first launch, MCPJam shows a **Welcome** overlay that guides you through connecting your first
server. You can:\n\n* **Enter your own server** — paste an HTTPS URL (e.g. `https://your-server.example/mcp`) or a STDIO command (

Terminal, Desktop, and Docker only).
* **Try the Excalidraw demo** — a hosted diagramming MCP app, no setup required.

After co
nnecting, MCPJam shows the server name and tool count, then offers an **Open Playground** button that seeds the chat with the prom

pt:

```
What can this server do?
```

Press **Send** to explore your server's tools. No API key, ngrok, or ChatGPT/Claude s

ubscription needed.

> [!TIP]
>
> You should see your server show **Connected** and its tools listed in the Playground's left
